facts.business: The company owns and operates offshore support vessels (OSVs) — one Platform Supply Vessel and two Anchor Handling Tug Cum Supply Vessels — chartered to oil exploration and production companies.

capacity_or_capex.item: Fleet additions (vessels, equipment, dry dock, modifications)

key_risks: Cyclical and volatile offshore charter rates
High asset concentration: fleet represents 84% of total assets
Dependence on oil & gas E&P spending and geopolitical events (e.g., Middle East conflicts)
Aging fleet and limited newbuild supply affecting utilization
War-risk insurance and operational cost escalation
Impairment risk on vessel carrying values
Regulatory and compliance risks including re-listing eligibility
